newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-STREAK TO UNDERGO FITNESS TEST BEFORE SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-STREAK TO UNDERGO FITNESS TEST BEFORE SECOND TEST.

text.p: Zimbabwe strike bowler Heath Streak will undergo a fitness test on Wednesday morning before the start of the second test against Sri Lanka after straining a groin muscle in the first test.
Left-arm paceman Bryan Strang will play if Streak is not fit.

The well-grassed pitch at the Sinhalese Sports Club is expected to favour the faster bowlers, a welcome sight for Zimbabwe who slumped to an innings defeat in the first test against the Sri Lankan spinners.
"The Sinhalese Sports Club suits our game," said Zimbabwe captain Alistair Campbell. "We won't be making any drastic changes apart from reshuffling our batting order."
Campbell said he was confident his batsmen would handle left-arm spinner Jayantha Silva much better than in the first test.
Silva and off-spinner Muthiah Muralitharan shared 14 wickets between as Sri Lanka clinched victory within four days.
"We came up against a bowler like Silva for the first time," Campbell said. "It took us some time to pick him up.
"But most of the boys are pretty confident they can play him."
Sri Lanka may omit off-spinner Kumara Dharamasena in favour of 17-year-old left-arm fast bowler Nuwan Soysa who would take the new ball with Chaminda Vaas, also a left-hander.

Soysa, who stands 1.93 metres tall, has just returned from a three-month coaching stint with the Pace Foundation in Madras where former Australian fast bowler Dennis Lillee cited him as an exciting prospect.
He is likely to vie for the final place in the Sri Lankan team with paceman Ravindra Pushpakumara.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Roshan Mahanama, Sanath Jayasuriya, Asanka Gurusinha, Aravinda de Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Muthiah Muralitharan, Jayantha Silva, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Nuwan Soysa, Kumara Dharmasena.
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Grant Flower, Mark Dekker, Andy Flower, Guy Whittall, Craig Wishart, Henry Olonga, Craig Evans, Paul Strang, Andrew Whittall, Heath Streak, Bryan Strang.
